name: qfd_su_cbuf_g_m5-q13b-COMMIT
purpose: Qwen ROM TP8 slot cbuf_g_* (8 instances): M5-capped tile at the contract outline, far-ROM side S / SU side N (faces swapped versus the legacy kit qfd_su_cbuf_g_a/b, cap M8), pins and clock on M5 N/S only, pin flops firm at the pins, three 128x256 SRAMs with 20 um channels (the 1024x256 macro does not leave routable pin-edge channels in the slot), macro halo 5.4 um + pin-edge M5 guard, far-ROM latency as the static strap f_lat.

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_qfd_su_cbuf_g u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/qwen_sys/redesign_qwen/ot_qfd_crom_lbuf.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: tile_pos
bench.note: eight ot_qfd_su_cbuf_g die tiles (grp 0..7) bit-exact against the constant ROM contract at f_lat 11 / 17 / 5 / 30

bench.name: tile_neg
bench.note: MUT 1, MUT 2, NOWAIT, LATERR (strap one edge off the far ROM latency) each FAIL

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_cbuf_g_m5/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_cbuf_g_m5/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qfd_su_cbuf_g_m5 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_qfd_su_cbuf_g --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: storage re-partitioned: the one ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256 (174.7 um wide: 7.6 um pin-edge channels in the 194.4 um slot) -> THREE ot_sram_1r1w_128x256 (94.8 x 41.0 um, one column, >= 20 um channels on all sides, bank 0 / bank 1 / overflow+HEAD) at the ORIGINAL slot outline; RTL: f_q / f_fault / grp get pin registers (every face pin is a flop), the far-ROM latency constant FLP 11 becomes the static strap f_lat[4:0] (tag-line tap select, 0..31 edges); physical: faces swapped (far ROM S, SU N), all pins + clock on M5 N/S, routing and PG capped at M5 (legacy M8), pin flops firm at the pins, macro halo 2.16 -> 5.4 um, macro pin-edge M5 guard E+W, hold margin 30 ps; r2 (gate 17da18560: rs_q 2 x 512 loads, rst_n 316 loads, TT clock 280.6-384.3 ps): the macro-select register is one copy per lane (8 x 2 b, 64 loads each, gated with the lane's own decode), the rst_n port drives only a 2-sync + 3 kept-copy reset relay (answer side / prefetcher / tag line; release 3 edges after the port), kit recipe 2 (pin hold stages + pin flops)
